findings.claim: createDefaultWorkspaceRoot creates a sanitized unique directory below app.getPath(documents)/ChatGPT. Empty createLocal sources invokes it; explicit nonempty sources bypass it.

createLocal requires appearance(nullable), initializeDefaultWorkspaceGitRepository(boolean), name(string), sources(string[]). setActive defaults true. Wr deduplicates normalized paths; on this macOS local-host branch, Ur returns the supplied path unchanged.

confirmProjectFolders is injected as projectFolderConsent.confirm. It queries app-server config/read project trust and uses a registered renderer callback for untrusted/unclassified folders. It does not call Electron native folder-picker APIs. It may config/batchWrite trusted folders in unified project mode after confirmation.

projectFolderPicker.createOrSelectProject with non-null root calls its validation method #t rather than picker #e; null root calls native showOpenDialog. The explicit createLocal path is independent of this picker and still performs folder trust consent.

testRecommendation.candidate: Use a preexisting task-owned absolute /private/tmp directory as the sole nonempty source. Keep new CODEX_HOME and userData, observe and review folder-trust UI, verify saved project root.
limitations: Static analysis does not prove the current renderer exposes a sources input or provides a route to the RPC from UI.
Do not call empty-sources/default-workspace or skip-workspace flows when the intention is to avoid Documents/ChatGPT.
Explicit sources does not itself suppress the app trust callback; trusted paths, empty folder-list, or the narrow unified-project generated-default exception can avoid that callback.
Creation writes project state, may reassign unassigned threads before changing roots, and may write trust config; these are part of the contract.
